name: Interior

text: A shelf with a clock on it, and the clock is right.
It is right because somebody sets it off the signal gun at the halt every morning.
Before the line, this village kept its own time and it was eleven minutes out.

_plan: One cottage on Station Road, opened so the railway gets said once from inside a home. The clock is the whole scene: a village that used to keep its own time and does not any more, and nobody minds, and that is the thing worth noticing.
